title: Evidence-Based Scoring

scoring.scores_derived_from: Actual code artifact inspection in harness/ab-1/

per_dimension.vanilla_evidence: 10/12 requirements. Missing RBAC enforcement, no sort validation. Evidence: backend/main.py has 4 CRUD modules but no auth middleware.
per_dimension.factory_evidence: 12/12 requirements. RBAC designed in architecture.md. Sort validation in code. Evidence: backend/main.py lines 41-43, design/architecture.md permission matrix.

per_dimension.vanilla_evidence: No design document. API structured functionally but ad-hoc. No schema file. Evidence: harness has no design/ directory.
per_dimension.factory_evidence: Explicit design/architecture.md with entity, API, page tree, permission matrix. Evidence: design/architecture.md (43 lines).

per_dimension.vanilla_evidence: 7 tests pass. Covers basic CRUD + safety. Missing input validation tests. Evidence: tests/test_api.py.
per_dimension.factory_evidence: 10 tests + 1 HONEST_SKIP. Covers validation, sort, movement updates. CLASSIFICATION_FIRST. Evidence: tests/test_api.py + classification-log.md.

per_dimension.vanilla_evidence: Delete-with-stock alert present. .env has placeholders. No sort validation (SQL injection risk). No input sanitization. Evidence: backend/main.py delete handler, .env.production.example.
per_dimension.factory_evidence: Safety annotations. Sort validation. Input sanitization. .env reviewed annotation. Explicit delete safety message. Evidence: backend/main.py comments, .env.production.example.

per_dimension.vanilla_evidence: README covers install + API. No manifest. No architecture reference. Evidence: README.md (21 lines).
per_dimension.factory_evidence: README comprehensive with architecture ref + safety features. MANIFEST.json present. Evidence: README.md (40+ lines), MANIFEST.json.

per_dimension.vanilla_evidence: No guided workflow. No next-step hints. User self-manages. Evidence: no factory artifacts in harness.
per_dimension.factory_evidence: Guided workflow. Copy-paste commands. Structured phase outputs. Evidence: Factory artifacts demonstrate phase structure.

note: Scores are INDEPENDENTLY derived from actual code artifacts. AB-0 design scores (50/87) were NOT used. Scores differ from AB-0 because this is a different execution with actual code inspection.
